---
name: Takedown request (VoxHouse3D)
about: Ask for one of your structures to be removed from the VoxHouse3D dataset
title: "[takedown] "
labels: takedown
---

**Which build(s)?** Public id(s) from the VoxHouse3D dataset's `metadata/builds.jsonl` (e.g. `VH3D-w03-a78fe8df`), or the world and approximate coordinates.

**Why?** One sentence is enough (e.g. "I built this and do not want it in the dataset").

**How can we confirm the request is yours?** Optional. We honor requests in good faith; removal ships with the next dataset release.
